docs.description: Just a repository for my Black Shark 2 (skywalker). Like every single gaming phone designed and maintained by a subsidiary company (Black Shark, Nubia, ROG, etc), official support is almost non-existent. I have three gaming phones from these companies and, to be honest, they don't worth whatsoever. Considering regular phones just have the same hardware and cooling systems have improved a lot on them, just don't get a gaming phone. Of course unofficial support is also non-existent. These companies don't release their kernel and driver sources, not to mention the high amount of proprietary stuff in their Android implementations. An AOSP custom ROM for these phones would be a big waste of resources. Black Shark 2 doesn't even have root for Android 11 (JoyUI 12).
docs.title: Black Shark 2 (SKW-H0) Repository

docs.description: I needed to print Marjo151 excellent Katyusha model in 20mm scale (1:80), and some of the parts in his version was a bit too thin. In addition that model doesn't have any wheels or axles. I deisgned a new frame (or ramp) to hold the missile rack, made the rack a bit thicker and borrowed the wheels from AIM4's GAZ Truck model. To make it easier to glue on the wheels, I also made some simple axles. I also modified the truck bed somewhat to support the frame. As in Marjo's version, print the missiles halves and glue them together. The model is currently in 1:56 scale (same as Marjo's). In order to print it in 1:80, I rescaled it to 70% size in the slizer software.
docs.title: Katyusha BM-13 GAZ-AAA - remix (4788173)
